items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: the first and the only time that I seen Josephine Baker, she was in that show Liza at the Davidson Theater in New York.

ctx.x: Did you play any place in this country or did you just go to Europe?

No, we played every place but New York. The only place we didn't play was waiting for the passports. Oh, you played all over the East Coast? Now look, it was the first and the only time that I seen Josephine Baker, she was in that show Liza at the Davidson Theater in New York.
